findings.title: Firma funzione non protetta nel path text[]
findings.description: heads#>>'{<signature>,oid}' usa una firma con virgole come elemento non quotato dell'array path; PostgreSQL divide la firma in più segmenti, trova NULL e PHASE_OID fallisce. Anche il ramo che conserva OID stringa usa lo stesso path. Sostituire entrambi con (heads->'<signature>')->>'oid' oppure heads#>>ARRAY['<signature>','oid'].

build_recovery:
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib
P=Path(__file__).parent
b=json.loads((P/'BASELINE.json').read_text());e=json.loads((P/'EXTRA.json').read_text());new=json.loads((P/'INSTALL_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
def q(s):return "'"+s.replace("'","''")+"'"
def guard(e,c):return " IF ("+e+") IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '"+c+"' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;\n"
s="""-- Recovery template, intentionally non-executable before exact installed Root binding.
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL search_path TO pg_catalog,public,extensions;
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s';
DO $phase_recovery$
DECLARE expected_root text:='__INSTALLED_ROOT__';n integer;
BEGIN
"""
s+=guard("expected_root ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'",'PHASE_RECOVERY_UNBOUND')
s+=" PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('C1266:GENERIC-AI:AVAILABILITY',0));\n PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope('44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid);\n"
for t in ['mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness','mission_factory_owner.c464_control','mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_runtime','mission_generic_owner.runtime_policy','mission_generic_owner.provider_policy','mission_generic_owner.flow_runtime_gate']:
 s+=f' PERFORM 1 FROM {t} WHERE singleton FOR UPDATE;\n'
s+=' PERFORM 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions ORDER BY actor_user FOR UPDATE;\n'
s+=guard("(SELECT revision_sha256=expected_root AND observed_revision_sha256=expected_root AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=expected_root FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton)",'PHASE_RECOVERY_ROOT_DRIFT')
s+=guard("NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE master_session_id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac' AND state<>'completed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE status IN('reserved','authorized','provider_started'))",'PHASE_RECOVERY_INFLIGHT')
for sig,attrs in new['expected_attributes'].items():
 s+=guard('md5((SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('+q(sig)+')))='+q(attrs['source_md5']),'PHASE_RECOVERY_SOURCE_DRIFT')
for file in ['director_context.sql','manual_staff_effect_v1.sql','c1266_role_decision_v2.sql']:
 s+=' EXECUTE '+q((P/file).read_text())+';\n'
root=b['root']
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness SET canonical_preimage='+q(root['canonical_preimage'])+',revision_sha256='+q(root['revision_sha256'])+',observed_revision_sha256='+q(root['observed_revision_sha256'])+',client_build='+q(root['client_build'])+',independent_review_ref='+q(root['independent_review_ref'])+',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE singleton AND revision_sha256=expected_root;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','PHASE_RECOVERY_ROOT_CAS')
s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.c464_control SET release_sha256='+q(b['g2']['release_sha256'])+',review_sha256='+q(b['g2']['review_sha256'])+' WHERE singleton AND release_sha256=expected_root;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','PHASE_RECOVERY_G2_CAS')
for a in b['admissions']:
 s+=' UPDATE mission_factory_owner.provider_authoring_admissions SET release_sha256='+q(a['release_sha256'])+' WHERE actor_user='+q(a['actor_user'])+'::uuid AND release_sha256=expected_root;\n GET DIAGNOSTICS n=ROW_COUNT;\n'+guard('n=1','PHASE_RECOVERY_ADMISSION_CAS')
for h in b['headers']+[e['creation_header']]:
 if any(x in h['signature'] for x in ['director_context(','manual_staff_effect_v1(','c1266_role_decision_v2(']):
  s+=guard('md5((SELECT prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE oid=to_regprocedure('+q(h['signature'])+')))='+q(h['source_md5']),'PHASE_RECOVERY_BODY_MISMATCH')
s+='END $phase_recovery$;\nCOMMIT;\n';(P/'RECOVERY_TEMPLATE.sql').write_text(s)
print(json.dumps({'recovery_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'bound':False,'scene_mutations':0}))
